name: Motorized Scooter
description: A two- or three-wheeled device with handlebars, designed to be stood or sat upon, powered by an electric or gas motor that can propel it with or without human power. A small electric two-wheeler that isn't an electric bicycle, motorized bicycle or motorcycle lands here.

restrictions.rule: Two tandem wheels or three, handlebars, and designed to be stood or sat upon
Excludes motorcycles, electric bicycles and motorized bicycles
May not be ridden faster than 20 mph
Riders need a valid driver's license or learner's permit; a learner's permit holder needs no accompanying driver
Riders must wear a helmet meeting the registrar's standards, and may not carry passengers
Must comply with the federal motor vehicle safety standards that apply to it, and have working stop and turn signals
Kept to the right side of the road at all times, and not ridden between sunset and sunrise
May use all public ways except limited-access or express state highways posted against scooters or bicycles
